snip.t: Platelet function defects: Glanzmann thrombasthenia (rare), Bernard‑Soulier, antiplatelet drugs (aspirin, clopidogrel), uremia
Common medications include aspirin, antiplatelet drugs, anticoagulants, nitroglycerin, beta-blockers, and statins.
Clinical relevance: basis for NSAID/leukotriene-inhibitor/antiplatelet drug mechanisms (expanded further in Week 10)
